The Shelton Cleaning Standard

The differenceis built into every wash.

01 / 04

Professional Chemistry

Shelton chose Seitz professional chemistry because it represents the highest standard in textile care. Developed in Germany, its highly concentrated formulas are used throughout every laundry and dry-cleaning program and precisely measured for each load. The result is the strength and control needed to remove oils, makeup, and difficult residues while protecting the textile.

  • The highest standard in professional chemistry
  • Exceptional cleaning performance
  • Longer textile service life

02 / 04

Time & Temperature

Commercial cleaning requires more than warm water. Shelton’s industrial water heaters reach and hold 177°F, allowing sheets and towels to be washed at 160°F. Combined with the correct cycle time, chemistry, and mechanical action, that sustained temperature sanitizes textiles, improves the removal of oils and residue, and delivers a deeper clean without harming the fabric.

  • Sanitization built into the process
  • Deeper cleaning without compromising fabric quality
  • Sheets and towels washed at 160°F

03 / 04

Fabric Protection

Whiter should not mean weaker. Shelton never uses chlorine bleach as it weakens fibers and shortens textile life. Instead, we use oxygen bleach to sanitize, brighten, and break down difficult residues while remaining color safe and gentler on fabric. The result is cleaner textiles that retain their strength and appearance through repeated service.

  • Never chlorine bleach
  • Color safe oxygen bleach
  • Longer fabric service life

04 / 04

Precision Equipment

Precision carries through the entire production floor. Yamamoto high-speed, soft-mount washer-extractors provide programmable control over every wash formula. The Girbau FTQ towel folder produces consistent folds, while the Girbau Compact PRO ironer feeds, dries, irons, folds, and stacks flat linens through one controlled system. Our Girbau X20 flatwork ironer delivers consistent, professional finishing for event linens and delicate textiles. Together, this equipment gives Shelton control from the first wash step through final presentation.

  • Precision from first wash to final presentation
  • Programmable control for every wash formula
  • Consistent pressing, folding, and stacking

Professional Chemistry + Time & Temperature + Fabric Protection + Precision Equipment

Linens

Professional cleaning and finishing for guest-room bedding, dining linens, and other commercial textiles. Each program combines consistent cleaning standards with high-quality pressing, folding, and organization to maintain presentation, protect linen quality, and support a longer service life.

Who it serves

For hotels, restaurants, venues, and managed properties that need dependable recurring linen service. Each program is shaped around inventory levels, storage, service frequency, and the presentation standards your guests and customers expect.

What you can send

Programs can include sheets, pillowcases, duvet covers, tablecloths, napkins, runners, and other commercial linens. During setup, Shelton reviews material, color, construction, and volume so each item receives the appropriate cleaning and finishing process.

How we clean

Linens are separated by item type, color, fabric, and use so bedding and dining goods receive the process best suited to them. Each load follows a purpose-built formula using Seitz professional chemistry, with controlled water levels, cycle time, and temperature. Programs for spas and wellness facilities use formulas designed to remove massage oils, lotions, and body oils from sheets and treatment linens. Wash temperatures reach 160°F, with chemistry, time, and mechanical action controlled as part of the complete cleaning process. Shelton never uses chlorine bleach; oxygen-based bleach is used when appropriate to support cleaning and brightness while protecting fiber quality through repeated service.

How we finish

Sheets and table linens are professionally pressed, folded to a consistent size, and inspected during finishing. Clean goods are then sorted and organized around your operation’s storage and distribution needs.

  1. Inspect

    Cleanliness and condition are checked.

  2. Press

    Sheets and table linens are professionally pressed.

  3. Fold

    Set to a consistent size and format.

  4. Organize

    Sorted around your operation’s needs.

Towels

Professional cleaning, conditioning, and finishing for towels used throughout hotels, spas, fitness facilities, pools, and other high-volume operations. Each program is designed to maintain consistent cleanliness, softness, absorbency, and presentation through repeated use.

Who it serves

For hotels, spas, massage practices, wellness facilities, fitness centers, pools, and other operations with steady towel circulation. Programs are shaped around daily volume, towel types, storage capacity, and restocking patterns so clean inventory stays available through treatment schedules, classes, and peak-use periods.

What you can send

Bath towels, hand towels, washcloths, workout towels, pool towels, bath mats, robes, face-cradle covers, and other textiles. During setup, Shelton reviews material, color, weight, and use so each item receives the appropriate cleaning, conditioning, and finishing process.

How we clean

Towels are cleaned with purpose-built formulas using Seitz professional chemistry, controlled water levels, cycle time, and temperatures reaching 160°F. These formulas are designed to remove massage oils, lotions, body oils, makeup, and odor from towels and treatment textiles. Shelton never uses chlorine bleach. Oxygen-based bleach is used to sanitize, clean, and retain brightness while protecting towel quality and absorbency.

Softness & Conditioning

Towel programs include measured conditioning within the wash cycle to improve softness and feel after drying. Conditioner levels are set around towel type and use so goods return soft and comfortable without compromising the absorbency needed in daily service.

How we finish

Towels return soft and pass through our Girbau FTQ towel folder, which automatically detects towel size and produces a precise, repeatable fold across high-volume programs. Finished towels are inspected, bundled, and organized by type, department, or storage location for straightforward restocking. Robes and other specialty items can be folded or hung according to the program.

Uniforms

High-quality cleaning and professional finishing for chef coats, kitchen garments, service uniforms, and commercial workwear. Each program is designed to maintain consistent cleanliness and a sharp, professional appearance while protecting garment quality through repeated use.

Who it serves

For restaurants, hotels, casinos, catering teams, property operations, and other businesses that rely on clean, professional staff garments. Programs are shaped around garment types, team size, department, service frequency, and whether pieces are shared or assigned to individual employees.

What you can send

Chef coats, kitchen shirts, aprons, trousers, service jackets, branded shirts, front-of-house uniforms, and other commercial workwear. During setup, Shelton reviews fabric, color, construction, trim, branding, and use so each garment receives the appropriate cleaning and finishing process.

Chef Coats & Kitchen Garments

Shelton gives chef coats the high-quality commercial cleaning and professional finishing they need to look sharp through repeated use. Each coat is properly cleaned and pressed, helping your kitchen maintain a consistent, professional appearance and ensuring garments look new on the 500th use. The same standard applies to aprons, kitchen shirts, trousers, and other back-of-house garments.

How we clean

Uniforms are cleaned with purpose-built formulas using Seitz professional chemistry, controlled water levels, cycle time, and temperature. Kitchen garments receive formulas designed to remove food, grease, cooking oils, and perspiration while protecting fabric, color, trim, and branding. Shelton never uses chlorine bleach. Oxygen-based bleach is used when appropriate to support sanitation, cleaning, and brightness while protecting garment quality through repeated use.

How we finish

Chef coats, service jackets, shirts, and other garments are professionally pressed, placed on hangers, and protected for return. Each item is inspected and organized based on your needs.

Event Linens

Cleaning and professional finishing for event companies, venues, convention centers, and planners working with presentation goods, colored linens, and tight turnaround windows. Each program is shaped around fabric, color, batch size, finishing needs, and the date each order is required.

Who it serves

For event rental companies, caterers, hotels, venues, convention centers, banquet teams, and production partners managing changing orders and fixed deadlines. Programs can accommodate recurring service, seasonal volume, and event-driven production schedules while keeping goods organized by account or batch.

What you can send

Tablecloths, napkins, runners, skirting, chair covers, fitted pieces, banquet linens, and other specialty event goods. During setup, Shelton reviews fabric, color, construction, batch size, and turnaround needs so each item receives the appropriate cleaning and finishing process.

Color Care & Cleaning

Colored event linens are cleaned with Seitz formulas at controlled low pH levels to minimize fading and color loss through repeated use. New linens can receive a color-locking cycle during their first cleaning to help stabilize dyes and keep matching inventory visually consistent for longer. Water levels, cycle time, temperature, and chemistry are tailored to protect the color, appearance, and presentation your clients expect.

Mold Removal

Mold affected event linens do not need to be replaced, even on colored items! Shelton uses specialized chemistry and controlled processing to target mold and related discoloration while protecting fabric and color. Recovering affected goods can reduce unnecessary replacement and extend the useful life of your inventory.

How we finish

Event tablecloths are professionally pressed and hung to prevent fold lines and unnecessary creasing. Napkins are pressed, laid flat, and stacked to maintain a clean, consistent presentation. Runners, skirting, chair covers, fitted pieces, and other specialty goods are folded or hung according to their construction and use. Finished items are inspected and organized by item type or production batch for straightforward staging.

What requires review

Items with wax, adhesives, paint, color transfer, existing damage, or specialty construction require review before service. Rush turnaround requests should also be confirmed in advance so cleaning, finishing, and completion timing can be planned around the event date.

Specialty

Professional laundry, dry cleaning, and specialty care for garments and textiles that fall outside a standard commercial program. Each item is evaluated around material, construction, color, condition, and intended use to determine the appropriate cleaning and finishing process.

Who it serves

For theaters, houses of worship, clubs, hospitality groups, event teams, and other organizations with nonstandard garments or presentation textiles. Programs can be arranged for recurring specialty inventory, compatible batches, or individual items that require assessment before service.

What you can send

Costumes, choir robes, ceremonial garments, decorative textiles, drapery, specialty uniforms, and other unusual commercial pieces. During review, Shelton will determine the appropriate cleaning and finishing process.

Laundry & Dry Cleaning

Specialty items may be processed through commercial laundry, professional wet cleaning, or dry cleaning. Shelton uses Seitz professional chemistry for both laundry and dry cleaning, allowing each process to be tailored to the item and desired result.

What requires review

Specialty items are Shelton’s specialty. Together with Shelton Cleaners, we can process nearly every type of textile or garment. Because specialty goods vary widely, each account receives a thorough review before a quote is prepared. Contact us with questions or to discuss a specific item.
